timing_note: Actual reading and comparison preceded the timestamped in-memory audit. Exact review start is not recovered; function-check timestamps measure script execution only.
scope: Independent implementation/provenance review of the private root helper and its exact frozen inputs. No main() execution, positive payload write, fresh source-science approval, role/export approval or new repository gate.
independence: Reviewer did not author enum_successor.py, root provenance audit or root scientific assembly. Reviewer authored the five HCl/manual successor payloads, and previously authored some original biological proposals and performed earlier partition reviews; no scientific self-review is claimed. HCl/manual correspondence is checked here as a provenance/data binding only. The separate preparation_skeptic retains whole-scope scientific review.

findings.resolution: The original absent-claim same-index inference is removed. explicit_successor requires exactly one matching old proposal ID, new proposal ID and complete before claim in source-author correspondence, then verifies the complete after claim at its explicit successor index and LLM_SUGGESTION. All nine actual revised claims pass exact before/after correspondence; wrong IDs, ambiguous correspondence and changed full successor fail. A synthetic shifted successor index succeeds only with the explicit corresponding index. Selected and predecessor payload hashes are verified; the independent audit additionally verified every HCl correspondence old/new payload locator/hash against the selected proposals and bytes.

owner_preimage authenticates actual maintained bytes against before_sha256, rejects symlink/missing/stale existing owners, and refuses a claimed new owner when its destination already exists. Each selected row is tied to its original proposal capture, owner path and before hash; original capture SHA and original owner SHA are checked. The authentic owner function is used again for the final MANUAL exclusion pass. All actual bindings match and the stale-owner control refuses.

verified.native_history_append_control: Native event function called only in memory on the 92 changed records; each prior history list remains an exact prefix, and restoring original enum values/removing the one test event restores the full original record.
verified.component_and_other_contexts: ComponentEvidence context is explicitly refused; rollback equality preserves every component, amount, note, identity field and prior history field before the one appended metadata event.
verified.path_scope: Static guard resolves destinations under successor-v3/enum/proposed, refuses outside paths, root itself and existing/symlink destinations. The two executable path refusal controls both stop before any positive write. No maintained destination or source payload is written.
verified.historical_control_name: historical-human-object is only a synthetic inherited-object refusal control. Neither that name nor retention of the two historical MANUAL_CURATION objects proves human authorship. The helper history text expressly says authorship is not recertified.

limitations: Acceptance is limited to the exact helper/input hashes reviewed here, not a generic adversarial-input or repository-wide migration guarantee.

Source-author correspondence is loaded and its observed hash recorded by the helper; the helper does not independently verify an external immutable correspondence manifest. Independent current-input checks bind the full objects and actual selected payloads.
main() and positive guarded writes were not executed. Final generated artifacts, native schema/partonomy receipts and full scientific review remain the coordinator and separate final skeptic scope.

Within-root overwrite and symlink checks are read from the implementation; the supplied historical-destination control is rejected at the outside-root check and therefore is not an executable test of within-root overwrite protection.
No claim of race-proof filesystem security; ordinary exact workspace paths and input hashes were inspected.
mutations: Only new independent snapshots, check script and reports under successor-v3/reviews/enum-writer. No helper/payload/source/maintained/Git/GitHub changes.
